cards.anchor: Hypothesized correct initiating component/message/run citation within 12 simulated minutes, at most one full rerun, and preservation of the initiating record.
cards.burden: Instantiate the stipulated logs and two-slot history, charge each action, record viewed intervals, and score only after commitment. One full-view action costs one minute; commitment effort has no supplied cost.
cards.construction: Reset to completed run-1. Prohibit new full-suite execution. Select its retained full view, log lines 1-90 and run identity, then require a committed citation grounded in the inspected record before scoring. Preserve run-1 throughout. This proposed evidence gate permits a diagnosis only when the needed component, message and run are visible.
cards.defeat: Reject this route if the exercising role cannot commit a correct viewed-record citation within budget, guesses before viewing, or loses the initiating record. A failed exercise alone does not establish fresh-execution necessity; record any missing context.
cards.mutation: Replace the mandatory fresh full-suite execution dependency with a retained-record inspection and citation obligation.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: the retained full view enables a valid B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8 commitment after one charged view minute, zero full reruns and no record loss. The focused B7 prerequisite message alone cannot satisfy the same citation obligation.
cards.prediction_rival: Fresh-execution necessity predicts that the retained full view remains insufficient and indispensable context is unavailable without a new full run. A valid scored retained-record commitment would contradict that necessity claim in this fixture.
cards.probe: In separate reset repetitions, compare retained run-1 full inspection with one fresh full rerun plus its full inspection; keep the diagnosis rule, 12-minute budget and commitment-before-scoring procedure identical. Log actual citations and all actions. Include the supplied negative fixture: an unsupported CONFIG answer there fails, exposing fixture-answer guessing.
cards.rival: A fresh full-suite run supplies indispensable diagnostic context beyond identical retained evidence.
unknowns: No exercising-role commitment or scored success has been observed.
Procedural concealment within this packet is imperfect; knowing the supplied scoring key is not evidence of inspection.
Real cognitive cost and benefits in changing or multiple-root failures are unavailable.

cards.anchor: Hypothesized interruption of unnecessary repeated full reruns while preserving correct viewed-evidence diagnosis and the initiating record within the stipulated outcome limits.
cards.burden: Use separate tabletop histories for four crossed conditions, specify the exercised policy consistently, independently assign the view, and log the next requested action before execution. Charge all executed actions; no population behavior is measured.
cards.construction: Cross no fresh rerun versus one fresh full rerun with tail versus full inspection. Hold diagnosis demand, scoring and budget fixed. At the first subsequent full-rerun request, a proposed intervention substitutes full inspection of the selected retained run, then offers commitment. Log the original request and substituted action to distinguish a changed request from a prevented execution.
cards.defeat: Unchanged next requests across independently assigned views fail to support the visibility-to-demand link. If full inspection still leads to unsupported diagnosis, excessive cost or record loss, the proposed interruption fails the valued outcome. Preventing execution alone does not demonstrate changed demand.
cards.mutation: Separate view selection from execution and intervene at the hypothesized return link between downstream-only inspection and another full-rerun request.
cards.prediction_candidate: If visibility sustains the exercised policy loop, root-containing full views should reduce following rerun requests relative to tails in both execution conditions. Substituting full inspection after one rerun should permit an evidence-backed run-2 citation without a second rerun; these outcomes remain hypothetical.
cards.prediction_rival: A visibility-independent policy predicts the same following requests across tail and full views despite changed initiating-record visibility. A fresh-execution necessity account predicts no valid diagnosis in the no-rerun full-view condition.
cards.probe: Compare next requested actions across the four crossed conditions using M5, then compare substitution with an uninterrupted copy of the same policy. Record selected run, visible interval, citation, clock and history. Any second full rerun violates the at-most-one-rerun anchor; advancing to a third full run can additionally lose run-1. Use B7-only inspection as a boundary check: its prerequisite link must not count as a viewed CONFIG diagnosis.
cards.rival: Rerun demand follows a policy unaffected by initiating-record visibility, or fresh execution is indispensable regardless of view.
unknowns: O5 stipulates actions without establishing why they occurred or a repeated causal loop.
Responses depend on the exercised policy; tabletop results cannot establish real analyst motives.
Blinding, commitment behavior and interruption success remain untested; generalization beyond the unchanged fixture is unknown.
